post.instagram_caption:
Canva is cutting or moving 1,271 jobs, about 22% of its staff.

CEO Melanie Perkins called it "the hardest moment in our thirteen-year history." The company says growth slowed for the first time in a decade, and its 2026 growth forecast was reportedly cut from 30% to 20%. Teams are being merged, with fewer layers of managers.

Departing staff get at least six months' salary, and 12 months of healthcare where Canva provides it.

Why it matters: Canva did not name AI as the reason. It pointed to slower growth and fast-changing technology.

Source: DPA via Yahoo Finance, Nov 3, 2026.
